nora: quick flag from today's q4 compact regen: a cluster of locale issues on srt/ruby/rtl slices. en->ja BLEU down ~4.5 on srt subset.

wei: ouch. minimal repro?

nora: pasted two tiny ones:
JA SRC (vertical subtitles): 『終了』
REF: "That's the end."
BASE: tokens [A,B,C] -> "That's the end."
Q4: tokens [A,C] -> "That's the end"  (missing middle token, sometimes stray U+FF3D)

AR SRC: "(هل ستأتي?)"
BASE pre-detok ids: [LP, WORDS..., RP]
Q4 pre-detok ids: [RP, WORDS..., LP]  <-- order reversed before detok

haruto: sounds like merge-table pruning affected punctuation/subtoken boundaries (we did prune joiners).

maria: can you run float weights with q4 tokenizer? `--tokenize-only` will tell.

wei: did that; float+q4-tokenizer reproduces both issues. enabling `--protect-punct` in tokenizer fixes examples.

eval-bot: nightly-run meta: run_id=2026-05-06_02 samples=7k flagged=88 top=['ja-srt','zh-ruby','ar-bracket']

haruto: plan: 1) hotfix generator to enable punctuation protection for CJK + bidi ranges, 2) regen compact tables, 3) add unit tests for vertical/ruby/bidi cases to quant-onboard.

wei: bisection points to commit prune-joiners-2026-04-30. preparing hotfix. ETA ~1hr.

maria: pausing veridian-v2 canary on Dedicated until regen done.

haruto: hotfix landed (9f4b2e7), quick regen on subset shows flagged 88 -> 3 (non-blocking). scheduling full regen before unpause.

nora: closing loop  will open follow-up GH issue for tests and add a note to release playbook. :rocket:
